about: Upstream drift reviewed and knowingly not mapped yet, read by Invoke-Build DriftCheck (tools/drift). Each entry: item (a DriftCheck finding: operation:<operationId>, a fieldcov pointer such as engine:ContainerConfig/Foo or compose:service/foo or bake:target/foo, a surface item <source>:<kind>/<name> of a documentation-only source such as buildkit:flag/FROM --reset or compose:option/docker compose up --wait, or version:<source> for a moved documentation-only source DriftCheck cannot diff), reason (at least 20 characters), date (YYYY-MM-DD the decision was made), version_seen (the upstream release that brought it). A version:<source> entry accepts exactly version_seen, so the next release fails again; other entries accept the item whatever release brings it. Surface items knowingly not implemented after a re-pin belong in reference/_gen/deferred.d/upstream.json instead. Remove an entry once the item is mapped or the source is re-pinned: DriftCheck lists entries that matched nothing as stale.
